title: Homogeneity of Fourier Coefficients
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, $c\in\mathbb R$, $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and $S\subseteq[n]$. Then the uniform Fourier--Walsh coefficient satisfies $\widehat{(cf)}(S)=c\widehat f(S)$, where $(cf)(x)=c f(x)$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, $c\in\bbr$, and $S\subseteq[n]$, uniform Fourier--Walsh coefficients satisfy $\widehat{cf}(S)=c\widehat f(S)$.
